versions.changelog:
- Initial release of geekbi-ozon-shop-search-skill supporting real-time Ozon shop data queries and analysis via 极鲸云.
- Enables filtering and sorting by shop, entity, country, brand, category, product scale, followers, sales, revenue, rating, reviews, and opening date.
- Defaults to Russian marketplace (siteId=1); supports other markets with dynamic site selection.
- Limits queries to the first 200 results, with transparent reporting of filtering, sorting, sample, time, and aggregation sources.
- Adheres strictly to sourced data fields; does not extrapolate missing values.
- Operational status and judgments follow documented procedures and policies.
